title: Account access and addresses
body:
Saved addresses are not supported in this version of CommercePilot. There is no address book, Addresses page, address editor or address management tool. Account > Addresses and profile/settings pages do not exist in this demo. The assistant cannot check personal saved-address records.

The checkout preview and order detail display a fixed fictional demo delivery destination. This is not a saved personal address and cannot be edited through chat. No real parcel is shipped. Open My orders at /orders and select an order to see its demo delivery destination and timeline. The order list and detail require sign-in and show only the current shopper's orders.

To sign in, use Account in the header. Account opens a dialog with email and password fields. Demo shoppers use pre-created accounts. Signing out is available from that dialog. There is no public registration, password reset or account profile editor in this version.
